# owner() on the contract: the holder
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"0xfe7e25de55e5cbbecccb661f3679f873f72b9b0d","data":"0x8da5cb5b"},"0x544af1d"]}'
